summary: Iteration 3 tested: pickup cutoff logic, Square Order/Customer creation checkout, admin/CRM portal (login, session, rate-limit, protection, nav, logout), CSP, and customer-side regression. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASS. Frontend Playwright: all admin flows work end-to-end through the public URL (FastAPI -> Next.js proxy chain). Pickup select on /checkout shows EXACTLY 2 options (Friday July 24 + Saturday July 25) plus placeholder, cutoff-note correctly hidden (today is Sunday, pre-cutoff). Admin dashboard renders Square placeholder AUTHENTICATION_ERROR cleanly (as expected). No crashes, no broken layouts. Customer pages (/, /menu, /specials, /learn-more, /login, /register) all 200 with no regression, and customer header is correctly absent on /admin.

minor.issue: Cloudflare beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) is blocked by CSP script-src on /checkout and /admin/*. Only analytics; not user-facing. Consider adding static.cloudflareinsights.com to script-src or disabling the beacon.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: (1) whitelist static.cloudflareinsights.com in CSP script-src or drop the CF beacon to silence console noise. (2) When real Square sandbox keys are provided, re-run the take-payment card form and full checkout POST to confirm live Square Order+Customer+Payment path.
critical_code_review_comments: adminAuth.ts rate-limiter is per-process in-memory — will not survive Next.js restart or scale beyond a single instance. Acceptable for MVP single-instance Hostinger deploy but flag before horizontal scaling.

adminAuth.ts checkRateLimit() only reads lockedUntil and doesn't reset the count once lockout expires — after 15 min, next single failure re-locks immediately because count is still >=5. Consider resetting count when lockedUntil <= now.

backend/server.py CORS: allow_origins limited to localhost:3000 with a regex for preview.emergentagent.com — good. But the reverse proxy blindly forwards all incoming headers including Host mutations; low risk but consider stripping x-forwarded-* if not needed.
checkout/route.ts returns status 500 when Square is not configured but the message text is user-facing — could arguably be 503 (service unavailable). Minor.
proxy.ts (middleware equivalent) does not verify token cryptographically for pages before redirect — actually it does via verifyAdminSessionToken. Good.
test_credentials: Admin passcode: kingdomtreatz-staff-2026 (from ADMIN_PASSCODE in /app/frontend/.env). Customer auth: register any fresh email/password >=8 chars.
seed_data_creation: None. Rate-limit test uses random X-Forwarded-For per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://b0b1c486-a310-4321-877e-5f653e700291.preview.emergentagent.com. All /api/admin/* and /api/checkout traffic is proxied by FastAPI -> Next.js localhost:3000, so cookies (admin_session, access_token) work end-to-end. Old /app/backend/tests/test_checkout_api.py is stale (targets removed Python checkout). Use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_3.py for regression. Reaching /checkout REQUIRES adding an item to cart and clicking 'Initiate Order Request' (cart is in-memory zustand, no persist) — direct page.goto('/checkout') shows empty state. Sample Playwright flow present in this iteration's tool logs.

verified_ui_elements.admin-card-error: shows 'The card form failed to load...' (Square placeholder app-id)
verified_ui_elements.checkout pickup date select: exactly 3 options (placeholder + Friday July 24 + Saturday July 25) — pickup-cutoff-note correctly hidden (Sun < Wed 9PM cutoff)

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in scope of this iteration. All new feature branches (pickup cutoff, Square Order/Customer via `square` npm SDK, admin/CRM portal, proxy.ts route protection, FastAPI reverse proxy, CSP) are functioning end-to-end. Square-integrated pages return structured JSON auth errors (401 AUTHENTICATION_ERROR / UNAUTHORIZED) as expected while ACCESS_TOKEN remains a placeholder.
